title: Development and Validation of a Digital Optotype for Near Vision in Greek Language.
brief_summary: Primary objective of our study is to develop and validate a computer-based digital near-vision optotype based on the Greek version of the print MNREAD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adequate literacy of written Greek language

Exclusion Criteria:

* dyslexia
* attention-deficiency
* former diagnosis of mental diseases
* former diagnosis of psychiatric diseases
study_population: Normal- and low-sighted participants aged 18 to 75 years
